candidates.name: Get-ScheduledTask
verified_facts: Get-ScheduledTask retrieves the task definition object of a scheduled task registered on the local computer
The returned definition can be inspected before starting an existing task
semantic_limits: A registered definition does not prove the task is currently running or that required receipts were produced

candidates.name: Export-ScheduledTask
verified_facts: Export-ScheduledTask exports a scheduled task as an XML string
The XML can preserve the pre-start registered task definition for audit
semantic_limits: Exporting XML does not start, register, modify or prove execution of the task

candidates.name: Get-AuthenticodeSignature
verified_facts: Get-AuthenticodeSignature retrieves signature information for a file or file content
The cmdlet is Windows-only and reports signature status even when a file is unsigned
semantic_limits: Signature metadata supplements but does not replace the pinned Git blob SHA or prove the script executed

candidates.name: Resolve-Path
verified_facts: Resolve-Path returns fully qualified paths for existing items
LiteralPath treats characters exactly and does not expand wildcards
semantic_limits: Resolve-Path cannot resolve a path that does not exist and does not establish process ownership

candidates.name: Get-Acl
verified_facts: Get-Acl retrieves security descriptors for resources such as files and directories
The descriptor exposes ownership and access-control information
semantic_limits: ACL readback does not prove the canonical runner is alive or that output contents are valid
